class.name: OcgTDFDelta
class.brief_description: A set of AttributeDelta for a given transaction number and reference time number. A delta set is available at <aSourceTime>. If applied, it restores the TDF_Data in the state it was at <aTargetTime>.
class.description: ! A set of AttributeDelta for a given transaction ! number and reference time number. ! A delta set is available at <aSourceTime>. If ! applied, it restores the TDF_Data in the state it ! was at <aTargetTime>.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns true if there is nothing to undo.

method.name: IsApplicable
method.description: Returns true if the Undo action of <me> is applicable at <aCurrentTime>.

method.name: Labels
method.description: Adds in <aLabelList> the labels of the attribute deltas. Caution: <aLabelList> is not cleared before use.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
